typeRule: Legendary=myth; Fire=fire-breathing or fire-symbol creatures; Water=lives in rivers/sea/wetland water; Electric=thunder, storm and lightning powers; Ground=heavy land animals, diggers; Rock=karst/cave/stone; Grass=forest plant-eaters & tree-dwellers; Sky=birds & flyers; Insect=bugs; Poison=venomous/poisonous
sortNote: dex = số thứ tự trong Google Sheet (V001…): 50 Vinmon đầu theo A–Z tiếng Việt, Vinmon mới nối tiếp theo bậc rồi tên
typeChartNote: Attacker -> defender multipliers; anything not listed is 1x. From Pokemon's Gen 6+ chart (Sky = Flying, Insect = Bug). Against a dual-type defender the multipliers multiply, as in Pokemon. Pokemon's 0x immunities listed in typeChartSoftened are 0.5x here.

legendaryRule.note: A Legendary-type unit deals x1.25 damage to every type and takes x0.75 from every type, on top of its other type's matchups. Legendary vs Legendary: 1.25 x 0.75 = 0.9375.

statRule.note: Pokemon-style base stats. Total set by tier; split by body plan. Physical attacks use atk vs def, special use spa vs spd. Range in hexes: 1 melee, 2 swoop, 3 ranged. attackType is the unit's first non-Legendary type.
